## User-visible change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue or relevant spec; distinguish implemented behavior from future plans.

## Verification

List commands actually run, results and any skipped checks with reasons. The complete test command is `npm test`; application changes also need `npm run build`.

For UI changes, attach before/after desktop and narrow mobile screenshots made with fictional data. Include affected empty/error states and keyboard/accessibility changes where relevant.

## Data and privacy

Describe effects on local storage/migrations, backups, exports, dependencies, network requests or external services, or state "No change."

- [ ] I reviewed the diff, logs and attachments for private screenshots, raw storage/backups, clipboard contents, identifying filenames and secrets.
- [ ] Documentation/specifications and meaningful tests are updated for the changed behavior, or I explained why they are unnecessary.
